Hi Sara — thanks for the heads-up and for the usage CSV, that was helpful.

We can absolutely help avoid a hard stop. Two options I can offer now:

- Short-term provisional credits: 72 hours of token credits to finish the burst testing (no billing until PO arrives).
- Environment keepalive: extend the sandbox for 7 days with throttled quota so your engineers can run targeted tests while procurement completes.

If you want the provisional credits I can route a quick approval internally — I just need a brief confirmation from procurement that the PO is in flight and an expected sign date. If legal has DPA questions we can loop in our compliance team.

Would you like me to put the provisional credit request into the internal approval queue now?
